run_meteor_quality_estimation: run the meteor translation quality estimation tool on a file of repeated translations and write scores to an output file
read_translations: read a file of repeated translations and group them into segments by the number of repeats
generate_input_for_meteor: generate temporary reference and machine translation input files from grouped translations using all pairwise combinations
run_meteor_jar: run the meteor JAR via subprocess with custom parameters and language settings on reference and translation files
read_meteor_output: read meteor scoring output, compute average scores per segment across all combinations, and return the list
